title: Web: Setup
description: GET /api/coach/setup. The Setup tab's section list. This schema is the envelope; each section is a view part with a one-line summary (web_setup_summary.schema.json, checked by fa_coach.views.errors) and its own detail view GET /api/coach/setup/<section>. The eight sections, in order: phase_targets, activity, messaging, training_plan, exercises, context_notes, profile, measurements. The page shows a section without a part as coming soon.

setup_open.description: A phase setup is being collected in Telegram: the web edits nothing until it is confirmed or cancelled there.
